text:
maria_cs: Quick capture from last week's microsurveys with 6 pilot accounts — recurring asks around embeddings and search relevance. TL;DR: customers want a per-route relevance boost, easier negative examples upload, and clearer cost impact for embedding refreshes.

maria_cs: sample quote: "Search is fine for discovery but we need prioritization weights per field (title > snippet) — docs unclear."

survey_bot: automated-survey: 6 responses, avg satisfaction 3.4/5, top pain tags: embeddings:update-cost, relevance:tuning, onboarding:docs. link: https://redwood.internal/surveys/1713

devon_prod: thanks! can you paste the exact wording customers used for the "per-route boost" ask? product wants to scope work.

maria_cs: sure — one said: "If we could surface a weight slider per route or dataset that would be ideal. Right now we change embedding params globally and it breaks other routes."

ashley_pm: putting in context — this is blocking a mid-market pilot (Skyline) renewal conversation. They said they'd be willing to pay for a per-route tuning add-on. tagging @devon_prod for prioritization.

lee_se: interim workaround: you can maintain two models/embedding configs and route queries by prefix. snippet: ```json
{"route":"/support","embed_model":"text-embed-002","weight":1.2}
```

lee_se: downside is double storage + more refresh cost. also needs routing logic in app.

sam_engineering: FYI, we could expose per-route boost as an index-time scalar in the Private API, but Hosted needs quota/cost guardrails. Also need to check cache invalidation mechanics for partial refreshes.

devon_prod: can we get numbers? maria, do we have sample query volume + embedding size per customer to estimate cost delta for Skyline?

maria_cs: Skyline: ~2M queries/month across 3 routes, embedding size 1536 dim, refresh weekly. estimated extra token/GB ops — rough calc in sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/emb-costs-skyline

ashley_pm: proposal: 1) triage as paid add-on (quick ROI) 2) small UX: per-route slider + docs 3) engineering spike to validate caching/rollout. Prioritize as P2 for this quarter? thoughts? :thinking_face: 

lee_se: agree P2. engineering spike estimate 2 wks (investigate cache semantics + billing metrics).

sam_engineering: add-on billing + quota changes will need finance signoff. cc @finance (separately).

devon_prod: ok — maria pls capture the pilot ask as a feature request card with example quote, impact (renewal risk), and cost ballpark. I'll queue spike in next triage.

maria_cs: done — created feature card: https://redwood.internal/boards/req-1713004567 (includes survey export + Skyline notes).

maria_cs: one more small ask from two customers: UI to upload negative examples (CSV) that map to route+label, small UX item that could reduce tuning time.

ashley_pm: that sounds like a quick win — move to backlog grooming.

devon_prod: thanks all. will update Skyline renewal playbook after spike results. :thumbsup:
